scope: Packaged native startup, first-run consent and offline update/release UI; no clipboard access, network download or installer execution by the updater.
limitations: No complete interactive installer or cross-application clipboard test.
No Apple Developer ID signing/notarization or Windows developer-certificate signing.
RPM metadata only; Fedora/RHEL installation and startup not tested.
ZIP/TAR startup, login auto-start and Wayland not tested.

checks: Packaged app identity, version and native architecture
Manager renderer and restricted preload IPC are available
Visible first-run consent with collection disabled and empty history
Renderer sandbox, isolation, web security and no Node globals
Bundled Korean font loads for offline UI rendering
First-run UI rendered without observed renderer exceptions
Offline update controls, release notes, support email and titlebar alignment
